definitions.explanation: A piece of material that forms part of a larger structure or product. Used in construction, engineering, and manufacturing to refer to individual components such as beams, panels, or frames.

examples.japanese: {部材|ぶざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧。
⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部材|ぶざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{加工|かこう}される→加工する：25223_kakousuru⟧。
examples.english: The structural members for wooden houses are processed at a factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部材|ぶざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{箇所|かしょ}→箇所：00196_kasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}した→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧。
examples.english: We inspected the aging bridge's structural members one by one and identified the parts that needed replacement.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ('part; section') and ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ ('material; timber'). Refers to individual pieces that are combined to form a structure or product. The word sits between raw materials and finished products — a {部材|ぶざい} has already been shaped or prepared but has not yet been assembled into the final structure.

USAGE:
Common in construction, architecture, and manufacturing contexts. Often appears in technical documents, building regulations, and product catalogs. Can refer to materials of any kind — wood, steel, concrete, plastic — as long as they serve as components of a larger assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部材|ぶざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧: to assemble components
- {部材|ぶざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加工|かこう}する→加工する：25223_kakousuru⟧: to process materials
- ⟦{鉄骨|てっこつ}→鉄骨：24552_tekkotsu⟧{部材|ぶざい}: steel structural members
- {木|もく}{部材|ぶざい}: wooden components
- {部材|ぶざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強度|きょうど}→強度：27803_kyoudo⟧: strength of the member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧: parts — individual components, especially of machines and devices; more common in manufacturing and electronics
- ⟦{資材|しざい}→資材：19470_shizai⟧: materials; supplies — raw or processed materials before they become specific components
- ⟦{建材|けんざい}→建材：12646_kenzai⟧: building materials — specifically for construction, a subset of {部材|ぶざい}
- ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: raw material — the unprocessed material before it is shaped into a component
